statement: The local-model quality and throughput figures mcgyvr ships in data/capability-table.json are measured on real hardware, not estimated or interpolated — including qwen3-coder-30b-a3b at 87.8% HumanEval+ pass@1 in roughly 3 GB of VRAM.

citations.supports_because: Records the qwen3-coder-30b-a3b run directly: Q2_K GGUF under llama-server, HumanEval+ 164 tasks, greedy decoding, 92.7% base / 87.8% plus at ~3 GB — the exact figure the table carries.
Records the dense Qwen2.5-Coder runs (1.5B/3B/7B) with framework version, decoding settings and hardware, which are the provenance fields reproduced per-measurement in the shipped table.
Second rig, independent run: supplies the 14B and MoE figures and the cross-rig comparison that lets the table express ratios rather than single-machine absolutes.

Source for the table's backend block and concurrency findings CON-04 through CON-06: the measured batching curve to 16 concurrent, prefix-cache hit rate, and sleep/wake timings, with the reproduction scripts alongside it. Also supplies the second independent instance of CAV-04, where a marginal fit made the faster backend 38% slower than the simpler one.
